name: Residence of Bukovinian and Dalmatian Metropolitans
description: In the Ukrainian city of Chernivtsi, this red-brick complex was built between 1864 and 1882 for the Orthodox metropolitans of Bukovina and Dalmatia. Czech architect Josef Hlávka blended Byzantine and other styles into a seminary, a monastery and a residence, all grouped around a domed, cross-shaped church and a landscaped park. Today the buildings house Chernivtsi University.
